import gzip

archive: gzip.GzipFile
match {"archive": archive}:
    case {"archive": captured}:
        captured.read()
match {"outer": {"archive": archive}}:
    case {"outer": {"archive": nested_captured}}:
        nested_captured.read()
match ({"archive": archive},):
    case ({"archive": sequence_captured},):
        sequence_captured.read()

subject = {"archive": archive}
match subject:
    case {"archive": aliased_captured}:
        aliased_captured.read()

match (named_subject := {"archive": archive}):
    case {"archive": named_captured}:
        named_captured.read()

condition = True
if condition:
    branch_subject = {"archive": archive}
else:
    branch_subject = {}
match branch_subject:
    case {"archive": branch_captured}:
        branch_captured.read()
